"previous_rows": [{"source_id": "fr81-u145-r0030", "target": "Фошлеван дошёл до той минуты, когда человек уже не знает, что говорит.", "source_sha256": "d2265c140c6738dbf6cef8f826ddc4e8c75cf9f0a8c7dbcaab051ca8080b6f7b", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u145-r0030", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "6c06f2d380b2cd854007be3624c9ed28e7612121dd11954320e1a9eb75004ad1"}, {"source_id": "fr81-u145-r0031", "target": "— Да идёмте же пить, — закричал он, — ведь плачу я!", "source_sha256": "tag": "prose", "text": "— Quand nous aurons couché l’enfant, dit le fossoyeur.", "sha256": "51a83c1a4cf76dd082c5fe4309b659e5243a8c405ab12173f5957562ff8051e5", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0033", "tag": "prose", "text": "Il jeta la troisième pelletée.", "sha256": "88d80cc6c04e7331a327aad48984589c76dcbf503b042261a0d0c0cd342540b8", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0034", "tag": "prose", "text": "Puis il enfonça la pelle dans la terre et ajouta :", "sha256": "76a35a75d3a96e972c88542777c1106a09dcd1178a750c0bf3b92b3562721733", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0035", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Voyez-vous, il va faire froid cette nuit, et la morte crierait derrière nous si nous la plantions là sans couverture.", "sha256": "7e82c3af0baf893b529842a9cc9448a964e15634520faa2f644021166c1748fd", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0036", "tag": "prose", "text": "En ce moment, tout en chargeant sa pelle, le fossoyeur se courbait, et la poche de sa veste bâillait.", "sha256": "1e53a18356dcfd5351223f407657d975e7985900d129142209fab947863feda5", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0037", "tag": "prose", "text": "Le regard égaré de Fauchelevent tomba machinalement dans cette poche, et s’y arrêta.", "sha256": "aafa8c0f33f796ab984dff2a98382da62eddf58ec56366c8eebab734e5c04464", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0038", "tag": "prose", "text": "Le soleil n’était pas encore caché par l’horizon ; il faisait assez de jour pour qu’on pût distinguer quelque chose de blanc au fond de cette poche béante.", "sha256": "c62a7fa87a5a6bb077bebfc61fcf9c18195c3ac966d9bef1b947531494aa4787", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0039", "tag": "prose", "text": "Toute la quantité d’éclair que peut avoir l’œil d’un paysan picard traversa la prunelle de Fauchelevent. Il venait de lui venir une idée.", "sha256": "8ba32f4dca4c422c8cf8bd30b1f5f7b55f83228d92f7d1068b807b788db7cc43", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0040", "tag": "prose", "text": "Sans que le fossoyeur, tout à sa pelletée de terre, s’en aperçut, il lui plongea par derrière la main dans la poche, et retira de cette poche la chose blanche qui était au fond.", "sha256": "cc9edd8a1fa928590a75c0f944830b40c9fdcfed2145fb2076ec943aab862a89", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0041", "tag": "prose", "text": "Le fossoyeur envoya dans la fosse la quatrième pelletée.", "sha256": "c74f515331728d6fe47fbd99d057112c073b7d5f1104841c45b039096022c29d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0042", "tag": "prose", "text": "Au moment où il se retournait pour prendre la cinquième, Fauchelevent le regarda avec un profond calme et lui dit :", "sha256": "8e16b97ca1210145f1cf8b80ddba40088990ec72fd2d9322c32b9c44da0c80ae", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0043", "tag": "prose", "text": "— À propos, nouveau, avez-vous votre carte ?", "sha256": "c6e12abb006ed452dfe3c152587a0e0b51c7e151ce171bdaa5ddc54764b9b3ea", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0044", "tag": "prose", "text": "Le fossoyeur s’interrompit.", "sha256": "94c9a67d6ed4bd0fba02b35a4928311caecba613831208f229dc2384eb5a7802", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0045", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Quelle carte ?", "sha256": "5256c9642e063bc8ab8d7772a6c13f43f8a7a2179eced4debbc7e7e6d6f30e63", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0046", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Le soleil va se coucher.", "sha256": "18a01baffd8cb5c02739b3753978dede0e3dc93513e2f702aed7008ee7030505", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0047", "tag": "prose", "text": "— C’est bon, qu’il mette son bonnet de nuit.", "sha256": "f1210d667665118c3269e94902f5639dd56893ba5d303faf1bd1d4f7032d6531", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0048", "tag": "prose", "text": "— La grille du cimetière va se fermer.", "sha256": "f312bca432e437c6d6bcd4b3e5848322061fe5e0bed3038da2d1708755b2c716", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0049", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Eh bien, après ?", "sha256": "3cb3ef6a0a446ce6225771556227fba2c505f01666d86c2bf6ff2d2a21b79bb7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0050", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Avez-vous votre carte ?", "sha256": "51b5fbd866b4e6e0e0660a841dd1531a140269913b650211db5c3abf313fa540", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0051", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Ah, ma carte ! dit le fossoyeur.", "sha256": "fb0d1a5eedbb2640d6a8b5426e20a23f38a25e7316604e89fc63cccc286f943a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0052", "tag": "prose", "text": "Et il fouilla dans sa poche.", "sha256": "6f2ecda12c6b92eeda5b845e2b84b5bad6841ec3b0fdc69e1305939943c8befc", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0053", "tag": "prose", "text": "Une poche fouillée, il fouilla l’autre. Il passa aux goussets, explora le premier, retourna le second.", "sha256": "ac52bbd1834ec5cd71d0f3f8261745ebc95245993b84c04594678b04afb20c75", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0054", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Mais non, dit-il, je n’ai pas ma carte. Je l’aurai oubliée.", "sha256": "ed5ebe1a7323fb4ef6153294277bcbbe568fd48d19cfe656ce70f5d3a7d80ac5", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0055", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Quinze francs d’amende, dit Fauchelevent.", "sha256": "e84a31fc19b11cecb27911e07d47abb441dc86a48da477ec24e0710ef77601dc", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0056", "tag": "prose", "text": "Le fossoyeur devint vert. Le vert est la pâleur des gens livides.", "sha256": "580e0c4d48f3d2aa3e04e69d2ed49de36f49e5c6e8601b02bf02c1d37568cc71", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0057", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Ah Jésus-mon-Dieu-bancroche-à-bas-la-lune ! s’écria-t-il. Quinze francs d’amende !", "sha256": "1f9ccd74dd78654853ed58a62225843d97d2fd5c3c6b5e1ed500ad3e89f5b765", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0058", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Trois pièces-cent-sous, dit Fauchelevent.", "sha256": "46d1980c393e9622e6bd58c8e098cba95cb8b27a4ad87d2e5580d861f3d9f6eb", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0059", "tag": "prose", "text": "Le fossoyeur laissa tomber sa pelle.", "sha256": "7ae25776857422fa21da6602cff1c4cf3fc53503e8bf43320cb1dd185ec86f5d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0060", "tag": "prose", "text": "Le tour de Fauchelevent était venu.", "sha256": "dd04822b803b62018b37e666501d7bdfe0ddcb37853018f22677e416fdfd892e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0061", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Ah çà, dit Fauchelevent, conscrit, pas de désespoir. Il ne s’agit pas de se suicider, et de profiter de la fosse. Quinze francs, c’est quinze francs, et d’ailleurs vous pouvez ne pas les payer. Je suis vieux, vous êtes nouveau. Je connais les trucs, les trocs, les trics et les tracs. Je vas vous donner un conseil d’ami. Une chose est claire, c’est que le soleil se couche, il touche au dôme, le cimetière va fermer dans cinq minutes.", "sha256": "2b7e3bc236062ab845fbb7473ec6198944af9b7be6fd3f4af6b3eb87d44a4c58", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0062", "tag": "prose", "text": "— C’est vrai, répondit le fossoyeur.", "sha256": "ba735687396d670f7412cc674bb66e83f8238f2eda59eb078fcaf246b9e2f333", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0063", "tag": "prose", "text": "— D’ici à cinq minutes, vous n’avez pas le temps de remplir la fosse, elle est creuse comme le diable, cette fosse, et d’arriver à temps pour sortir avant que la grille soit fermée.", "sha256": "cc5fb61df79fb0bffde4dfcd7212f2844140af32587a645a9a626ffec636a198", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
